description:
Fixture and Finish is a selections and procurement platform built for custom home builders, interior designers, and design-build firms. This plugin brings your project data into ChatGPT so you can ask questions in plain language from anywhere — the office, the job site, or your phone.
Ask ChatGPT to:

Look up any item on a project — fixture specs, finishes, model numbers, dimensions, and installation details
Check procurement status across projects: what’s been ordered, what’s shipped, what needs a decision
Search your selection library of products you’ve already vetted and used
Import a product from any vendor page into your library and attach it to an item
Create follow-up tasks and reminders on a project

Instead of digging through emails, spreadsheets, and spec sheets, ask: “What’s the fan in the Leesburg primary bedroom, and how does the remote work?” or “What’s still unordered for the kitchen at Wilson Lane?” and get an answer grounded in your actual project data.
Fixture and Finish keeps selections, specs, vendors, and purchase status structured in one place, so client-facing docs, field schedules, and answers like these work out of the box. Requires a Fixture and Finish account; trials are free with no credit card required.

defaultPrompt: Give me a list of all my projects
What faucet did we approve for the powder room at 6801 Granby Street?
Find a matte black robe hook for the primary bath at 6801 Granby Street, and add it as an option for me to review.
